purpose: Research and data acquisition planning; no raw source data acquired in this stage.
interpretationRules: The Living Planet Index measures average relative change in monitored wildlife populations; it is not the percentage of animals that disappeared.
Occurrence and observation counts are not population abundance estimates.
Do not use restricted IUCN data without appropriate authorization.

sources.name: Living Planet Report 2026
sources.data: Report findings, methods and potentially supplementary data; 2026 contents not independently verified in this pass.
sources.coverage: Edition-specific monitoring period and sample coverage unverified.
sources.acquisition: Inspect official report hub and download report/supplement; no API confirmed.
sources.license: Unverified; inspect report and data-specific terms.
sources.citation: WWF, Living Planet Report 2026, exact page/figure and underlying data sources; verify final citation details.
sources.speciesLevelTrends: Aggregate report index: no; underlying LPD population series may, subject to terms.
sources.access: Report page public; data access/terms unverified.

sources.name: Living Planet Index and Living Planet Database
sources.publisher: Zoological Society of London and WWF
sources.data: Published aggregate index results and underlying monitored vertebrate population time series; portal states public LPD covers 1970–2020 and excludes confidential records.
sources.coverage: Global vertebrate population time series; exact acquired release must be pinned.
sources.acquisition: Browse results; submit use description and accept portal agreement for database download.
sources.license: Published index outputs and raw population records have distinct terms; confirm current policy/agreement.
sources.citation: ZSL/WWF, LPI/LPD release/version, retrieval date, and underlying sources as agreement requires.
sources.speciesLevelTrends: Underlying monitored population series yes; global index is aggregate and not species-specific.
sources.access: Portal access public; bulk download requires use description and agreement.

sources.name: IUCN Red List of Threatened Species
sources.data: Taxonomy, assessment category, criteria, range, threats, conservation actions and sometimes categorical population trend.
sources.coverage: Global, assessment-cycle based; record exact assessment date/version.
sources.acquisition: Request API v4 token and make permitted documented requests; avoid scraping.
sources.license: Official API documentation forbids commercial use; other restrictions may apply.
sources.citation: IUCN [actual year/version]. IUCN Red List of Threatened Species, plus assessment citation.
sources.speciesLevelTrends: Sometimes qualitative trend category; generally not numeric repeated abundance time series.
sources.access: API token required; rate limits; noncommercial terms; authorization unresolved.

sources.name: GBIF occurrence data
sources.data: Occurrence records with taxonomy, dates, location, dataset provenance and licenses.
sources.coverage: Global, multi-taxon, continuously updated; highly uneven sampling effort.
sources.acquisition: Occurrence API for queries; registered GBIF account and authenticated asynchronous download for bulk requests; save DOI/citation.
sources.license: Per record/dataset; commonly CC0, CC BY or CC BY-NC. Check each.
sources.citation: Use generated download DOI/citation and dataset citations.
sources.speciesLevelTrends: No general population trend; occurrence/range evidence only. Observation counts are not abundance.
sources.access: Search public; bulk download requires registration/authentication and email/link workflow.

sources.name: Our World in Data
sources.data: Curated datasets, charts and explainers; LPI FAQ covers 2024 edition and 1970–2020.
sources.coverage: Dataset-specific; inspect chart metadata and update date.
sources.acquisition: Chart CSV/metadata or documented API/GitHub sources.
sources.license: OWID-produced materials generally CC BY; third-party datasets retain original terms.
sources.citation: Credit authors and OWID and cite underlying source datasets.
sources.speciesLevelTrends: LPI charts are aggregate; inspect individual chart metadata. Not a substitute for LPD.

sources.name: NOAA Fisheries science and stock assessments
sources.data: Species profiles, regional stock assessments, population estimates, status and selected sounds/media.
sources.coverage: Mostly U.S. jurisdiction and assessed stocks; report-specific years and boundaries.
sources.acquisition: Download linked assessment report/data from species/science pages; no universal API verified.
sources.license: Government works may be public domain; third-party material varies; inspect item-level notes.
sources.citation: Assessment authors, year, stock/unit and NOAA source page.
sources.speciesLevelTrends: Yes for selected assessed stocks/species, subject to unit and uncertainty caveats.

sources.name: BirdLife International Data Zone
sources.data: Bird taxonomy, ranges, conservation status, population/trend summaries and conservation geography.
sources.coverage: Global birds; factsheet and assessment dates vary.
sources.acquisition: Browse factsheets; request/download datasets under official terms; no public bulk API entitlement verified.
sources.license: Bulk data may be proprietary, permissioned or fee-based; confirm before use.
sources.citation: Use product-specific citation and assessment metadata supplied by BirdLife.
sources.speciesLevelTrends: Often categorical; some population estimates; repeated numerical series varies.
sources.access: Public browsing; bulk access may need registration, permission or fee.

sources.name: xeno-canto
sources.data: Bird sound recordings and recordist/location/date/species metadata.
sources.license: Recording-level licenses vary; confirm exact license and commercial/derivative conditions.
sources.citation: Recordist, xeno-canto record ID, source URL, license and required credit.
sources.access: Public search/API; terms and item licenses apply.

sources.name: Macaulay Library
sources.data: Wildlife audio, video, photo and metadata archive.
sources.coverage: Large ongoing archive; uneven by species, place and effort.
sources.acquisition: Find item page; request/download according to item access and reuse permissions.
sources.license: Item/creator rights vary; obtain permission for intended documentary/commercial use.
sources.citation: Follow item-specific creator and Cornell credit instructions.
sources.access: Browse public; high-resolution downloads/reuse may need account or permission.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.data: Community-hosted image/audio/video files with item-page provenance and license metadata.
sources.acquisition: Search/API; retrieve from individual file page.
sources.license: File-specific open license or public domain; attribution/share-alike and other conditions vary; Commons does not warrant metadata accuracy.
sources.citation: Creator, file page/source, license link and modifications.

sources.name: iNaturalist
sources.data: Community observations and separately licensed photos/sounds.
sources.acquisition: API for focused queries; dataset exports for larger research; check media and observation licenses separately.
sources.license: Contributor-selected licenses vary; NC material not suitable for commercial use.
sources.citation: Creator, observation/media ID, source URL and exact license; cite dataset where applicable.
sources.speciesLevelTrends: No reliable general abundance trend; record counts are not abundance.

sources.name: U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service media
sources.data: Agency photos, videos, audio and captions.
sources.acquisition: Download from item page and inspect rights/credit metadata.
sources.license: Many government-created works may be public domain; third-party works vary.
sources.citation: Follow item credit statement and photographer/agency information.
